# Benchmark results

<!-- Generated by `node bench/bench.mjs render`; edit bench/release.mjs, not this file. -->

npm release binaries, measured 2026-10-28: TypeScript 7.1.0-beta (`@typescript/typescript-darwin-arm64`) and tsrs 0.20.1-ts7.1.0-beta (`@tsrs/darwin-arm64`), which ports microsoft/TypeScript@3e9236361fa9. tsrs runs in its default mode and with the fast preset (`--fast`).

Each command is `-p <project> --noEmit --incremental false --pretty false`, plus `--fast` for tsrs --fast, on an Apple M3 Max (14 cores, 36 GB, Darwin arm64). Default-settings runs pass no `--checkers` and set no thread limit, so each compiler picks its own checker count and uses all 14 cores. Values are medians of 10 interleaved runs (5 for TypeScript), measured with Hyperfine 2.0.0. An untimed run of every command first warms the file cache and records its diagnostics. Each timed run waits until other processes use at most 1.5 CPU cores, for up to 900 s; 0 of 475 runs started after that wait expired.

The bar chart and tables compare all three with default settings. The chart shows the 6 projects with the largest tsrs --fast wall-time speedup over TypeScript; the tables include all 19 projects. Pinned projects are in [projects.json](projects.json); see the [methodology](README.md).

![Check time and peak memory by project](benchmark.svg)

## Type-aware linting on VS Code (local, 2026-10-15)

Two local release-build publishes on the same Apple M2 Max (12 logical CPUs, 96 GiB), macOS 27.0.1.
All 60 rules on the same 9,324-path public VS Code corpus. Each cell is the median of three alternating runs;
publish 1 includes warm-ups. These are separate from the CI type-check-only scoreboard above.
Before: `8dbe8842` release helper; after: the reviewed worker change. No PGO/BOLT.

| Publish | Workload | Rust before | Rust after | Go | Improvement |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | lint | 22.398 s | 9.214 s | 14.060 s | 58.9% |
| 1 | lint-typecheck | 33.053 s | 13.045 s | 20.907 s | 60.5% |
| 2 | lint | 15.246 s | 6.785 s | 11.005 s | 55.5% |
| 2 | lint-typecheck | 22.043 s | 9.589 s | 16.014 s | 56.5% |

`lint` includes on-demand types for rules; `lint-typecheck` also collects full compiler diagnostics.
Workers increase Rust peak RSS. [Instructions, RSS, single-worker controls, diagnostic checks and reproduction](../notes/perf-tsgolint-workers.md).
